packageRules.description: A new Kubernetes minor version needs work in k8s/patch.go, so it gets a pull request of its own.
The k8s module (tabernetes-overlay) only compiles inside the Kubernetes checkout.
A new minor version of the pod kernel may rename or drop options of vm/kernel.config, so it gets a pull request of its own. Patch releases merge when the boot test (vm/test/boot.test.mjs) passes.

customManagers.description: The pod kernel in vm/Dockerfile: a tag of the stable tree and its commit as the checksum of ADD.
